title: Marketplace: a loading line and a failure state instead of eight seconds of skeleton cards
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `efa9cb4fa`: Setup › Browse Marketplace draws six skeleton cards for about eight seconds while the catalog loads (the catalog request is remote), then the one HotCRM card. Nothing says what is loading, from where, or what happens if the catalog is unreachable; a user on a network that blocks the catalog sees skeletons forever.

## Target

1. Under the search box, one line while loading: "Loading the ObjectStack catalog…" with a spinner; after 10 s, "Still loading — the catalog is slow to answer" with a Retry.
2. On failure: an empty state with the error class ("The catalog could not be reached" / "The catalog answered with an error"), the Retry button, and the Installed tab still usable.
3. The skeleton shows for at most 2 s; after that the loading line stands alone.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePage.tsx`, the catalog hook, i18n keys in every shipped locale, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a catalog promise that rejects renders the failure state with Retry; one that resolves after 3 s renders the loading line.
2. Screenshots of the loading line and the failure state.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `0f4e3f4ee`, never merged): [r4-marketplace-skeleton-breadcrumb.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0f4e3f4ee/docs/design/review-r4-2026-10-16/r4-marketplace-skeleton-breadcrumb.jpg?raw=true) · [r4-marketplace-loaded.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0f4e3f4ee/docs/design/review-r4-2026-10-16/r4-marketplace-loaded.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 fourth review: objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, HotCRM `4f82b815` on platform 18.0.0-next.2, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (dark, en). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed on the repository it belongs to, verbatim: 「全部立卡，平台问题到 objectui，审计日志核查到 objectstack，HotCRM 转化流程到 hotcrm。」</sub>
